title: VBank Platform Overview
description: Uptime, SLI/SLO, latency, errors, HTTP traffic, container and node resources, dependencies and business KPIs for every VBank service.

panels.title: Business KPIs  (live from the VBank database)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM account
SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed FROM "transaction" WHERE status = 'completed'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed FROM "transaction" WHERE status = 'failed'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) AS balance FROM account
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed','failed')), 0), 100) AS success_rate FROM "transaction"

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: transactions still moving through the saga

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS in_flight FROM "transaction" WHERE status IN ('initiated','debit_success','credit_success')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS volume FROM "transaction" WHERE status = 'completed'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(amount), 0) AS avg_amount FROM "transaction" WHERE status = 'completed'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS external FROM "transaction" WHERE NOT is_internal
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(a.id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0), 0) AS ratio FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = u.id
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), status::text AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM "transaction" WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), SUM(amount) AS "volume" FROM "transaction" WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT status::text AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "transaction" GROUP BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), COUNT(*) AS "new users" FROM "user" WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), COUNT(*) AS "new accounts" FROM account WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT created_at AS "time", transaction_id, source_account_number AS "from", destination_account_number AS "to", amount, status::text AS status, CASE WHEN is_internal THEN 'internal' ELSE 'external' END AS kind FROM "transaction" ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
